g.text: SUPERSEDED HISTORICAL PLAN, not runtime · replaced on 2026-07-25 by shared_driver_semantic_return_plan; retained for E2-era traceability.

g.title: export to consumers
g.desc: Foundation pretraining consumes only frozen, versioned independent-tokenizer exports.

g.title: export to p6_coupling
g.desc: The final certificate follows foundation selection rather than bypassing it directly from export.

g.title: Unified measured local view
g.desc: Unified measured local view; unified window → local anchor; 20 s crop · 10 boundary patches; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: Entry-specific target router
g.desc: Entry-specific target router; local · prototype · context · coupling; detached · standardized · versioned; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence admitted; Replace the fixed five-state adapter contract with a versioned entry-specific target router.

g.title: EEG local / prototype
g.desc: EEG local / prototype; required r mean + slope; optional s mean + slope; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Keep r as required local/prototype semantics and expose s only as an optional ablation.

g.title: fNIRS local / prototype
g.desc: fNIRS local / prototype; HbO / HbR mean + slope; flow excluded locally; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence admitted; Route observation-aligned HbO/HbR to local/prototype losses while excluding flow from those entrances.

g.title: Per-entry masks + weights
g.desc: Per-entry masks + weights; local · prototype · context · coupling; uniform until uncertainty is calibrated; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Prevent one modality-level mask from authorizing losses with different receptive-field requirements.

g.desc: EEG patch + FFT; [B, 10, 6, 400]; patch-local only; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: Local EEG MLP; encoder feature 256; no absolute position; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: EEG semantic; continuous latent 64; state head → 6; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: EEG EMA VQ; K=128 · D=64 · count/sum; invalid tokens excluded; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: EEG residual; continuous latent 64; information preservation; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: EEG causal context; previous 5 tokens; target patch excluded; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: fNIRS patch + FFT; [B, 10, 2, 20]; patch-local only; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.desc: fNIRS causal context; previous 5 tokens; target patch excluded; scope inference; implementation implemented

g.title: Entry-routed objectives
g.desc: Entry-routed objectives; local · prototype · causal context; T0–T4 gradient audit; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Separate local, prototype, causal-context, and coupling-preservation objectives for T0-T4 ablations.

g.title: Three reconstructions
g.desc: Three reconstructions; semantic + residual; semantic-only · residual-only; scope training_only; implementation implemented

g.title: Tokenizer promotion gate
g.desc: Tokenizer promotion gate; gradient · mask · causal tests; G2 retention + G3 semantics; scope governance; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Promote only after mask, gradient, causality, null, information-retention, and registered-semantics checks pass.

g.title: Frozen checkpoint
g.desc: Frozen checkpoint; codebooks + model state; hash + run manifest; scope export; implementation implemented

g.title: P5 export v1
g.desc: P5 export v1; IDs · posterior · expected; residual · targets · provenance; scope export; implementation implemented

g.title: Foundation causal core
g.desc: Foundation causal core; multi-horizon q0 / q1; MLM + InfoNCE as ablations; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Add an explicit causal multimodal foundation objective instead of relying only on separate MLM and pooled contrastive alignment.

g.title: Independent certificate
g.desc: Independent certificate; fresh / cross-fitted q1 − q0; history · marginal · shift nulls; scope evaluation; implementation planned; evidence blocked; Use a fresh frozen or cross-fitted evaluator after tokenizer and foundation selection.

g.title: Future innovation targets
g.desc: Future innovation targets; primary flow innovation; HbO / HbR safeguards; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Add Future innovation targets

g.title: Disposable causal shaper
g.desc: Disposable causal shaper; fNIRS-history q0 + EEG q1; gradient to EEG tokenizer only; scope training_only; implementation planned; evidence guarded; Add Disposable causal shaper
